findings.evidence: Mathlib statement `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:1219-1221`: LHS is `((1 : Matrix o o α).submatrix e₁ e₂) * M` with `e₂ : m ≃ o` coerced; RHS is `submatrix M (e₂.symm ∘ e₁) id`. `projCastSucc` is defined with `id`, not `⇑(Equiv.refl _)` (line 89). `Equiv.coe_refl : (Equiv.refl α : α → α) = id := rfl` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Defs.lean:234` is the explicit lemma the `rfl` substitutes for.
findings.fix: Make the coercion normalisation explicit, e.g. `by have h := Matrix.one_submatrix_mul Fin.castSucc (Equiv.refl (Fin (n + 1))) A; simpa [projCastSucc] using h` (simp discharges `Equiv.refl_symm`, `Equiv.coe_refl`, `Function.id_comp`), or `rw [projCastSucc, ← Equiv.coe_refl, Matrix.one_submatrix_mul]; simp`. Alternatively keep the original `ext i k; simp [Matrix.mul_apply, projCastSucc_apply, ite_mul]`, which was already robust.
findings.issue: `(Matrix.one_submatrix_mul Fin.castSucc (Equiv.refl _) A).trans (by rw [Equiv.refl_symm]; rfl)` only typechecks because `projCastSucc n R * A` is unified by defeq with `(1).submatrix Fin.castSucc ⇑(Equiv.refl _) * A` (private def unfolded, coercion reduced to `id`), and the tail closes `⇑(Equiv.refl _) ∘ Fin.castSucc = Fin.castSucc` by `rfl` rather than by the named lemmas. Undocumented defeq through a wrapper and a coercion.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:1208-1210`: `M * (1 : Matrix o o α).submatrix e₁ e₂ = submatrix M id (e₁.symm ∘ e₂)` with `e₁ : n ≃ o` coerced; `inclCastSucc` (line 94) is stated with `id`.
findings.fix: Mirror the fix above: `by have h := Matrix.mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl (Fin (n + 1))) Fin.castSucc A; simpa [inclCastSucc] using h`, or restore `ext i k; simp [Matrix.mul_apply, inclCastSucc_apply, mul_ite]`.
findings.issue: Same pattern in `mul_inclCastSucc`: `(Matrix.mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl _) Fin.castSucc A).trans (by rw [Equiv.refl_symm]; rfl)` relies on the same silent unfolding of `inclCastSucc` and of `⇑(Equiv.refl _)` to `id`, and closes `⇑(Equiv.refl _) ∘ Fin.castSucc = Fin.castSucc` by `rfl`.

summary: The two rewritten product lemmas reuse Mathlib but do so via an implicit term-mode `change` (private def unfolded and `⇑(Equiv.refl _)` reduced to `id` by elaboration) plus a `rw; rfl` tail that closes the `Equiv.refl`/`id ∘` coercion goal by defeq instead of the available simp lemmas. Make those coercion steps explicit so the proof states why it works.
